newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends lower despite weaker dollar/yen.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends lower despite weaker dollar/yen.

text.p: The won finished down versus the dollar on Wednesday despite the weakening of the dollar against the Japanese yen in overseas markets, traders said.
They said the won was largely burdened with banks building their dollar positions on positive prospects.
The won closed at 830.60 after opening at 830.10. It traded in a range of 830.00 to 831.30.
"Dollar short-covering, coupled with long dollar build-ups and speculative buying, firmed the greenback," said a trader at Korea First Bank.
"But a softer dollar/yen prevented the dollar from rising too much," he said.
Traders expected Thursday's trade to be heavily influenced by the dollar/yen's movement.
A range of 829.60 to 832.00 is expected for Thursday with a base mid-rate at 830.80, they said. Today's mid-rate was pegged at 831.20.
